snippet.title: Pax Autocratica - Early Access Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
In Pax Autocratica, build a grand totalitarian colony then personally storm roguelite battlefields with your soldiers. Shape citizens fears, loyalties, bonds, and feuds. Capture enemies, convert them into true believers. Sacrifice the weak. Feed the strong. Wield absolute power and make every life bend to your will.

Early Access launching August 10 on PC via Steam.
Launch Price: $29.99 / €29.99 / £24.99 / ￥108 
Launch Discount: 17% launch discount for 2 weeks

Wishlist & Play the demo: http://store.steampowered.com/app/1067360/

All Hail the State.
